title: Northstone’s 186-home Heywood phase advances, but household costs remain unclear
body:
Northstone’s Hareshill Road phase has moved beyond its earlier promotion for up to 190 homes. The council’s June 2026 development update records planning approval for 186. That distinction matters when residents compare publicity with the scheme that will actually be built.

Russell LDP says Northstone acquired Parcel A in October 2025 and submitted reserved matters in November. The phase forms part of South Heywood’s wider 1,000-home programme, with access associated with Queen Elizabeth II Way.

Public reporting describes a range of housing, open space and landscaping, but the verified material here does not establish affordable numbers, rents, sale prices or estate-management charges. Energy-efficiency claims should be accompanied by actual specifications and predicted running costs.

The larger masterplan promises community facilities. This phase’s contribution to them, and the point at which delivery is required, need to be visible in the approved documents. A contribution is useful only if it results in adequate capacity when residents need it.

Search results for “Northstone” include court cases involving Northstone (NI) and overseas businesses. They have not been attributed to this Peel-associated housebuilder: a similar name is insufficient to establish corporate identity or responsibility.

Location: Hareshill Road North, South Heywood

Planning stage: Approval recorded in the June 2026 council update

Homes: 186 approved phase homes; earlier land promotion referred to up to 190

Let or for sale: Sales/rental split, affordable count and household costs not established

Land: Parcel within the wider South Heywood masterplan; parcel-specific land classification needs checking

Final planning agreement: The executed Section 106 deed, complete schedules, payment triggers and later variations were not verified. This is an evidence gap, not a claim that no agreement exists.

Exact rents / prices: Northstone markets Setl as coming in 2026, with three-, four- and five-bedroom homes and a registration list. The reviewed developer page supplies no price schedule; exact rents, affordable costs and charges are not verified.

Affordable breakdown: 186 homes approved according to the council update. No final affordable count or social-rent/shared-ownership/discounted-sale split established.

Funded school capacity: Within South Heywood: no phase-specific funded school capacity or enforceable school-opening trigger verified.

Funded healthcare capacity: No site-specific funded NHS expansion, additional staffed appointment capacity or delivery date was established from the accessible council/government records reviewed. Proximity to a surgery is not a capacity assessment.

Funded transport capacity: Access is associated with the wider link-road network; that delivered road does not establish this phase’s signed contributions or funded public-transport improvements.

The outstanding details identified above are not yet available to Rochdale Daily. This article will be updated when the information becomes available.

Research checked 14 October 2026. Advertised prices are snapshots, not achieved sale prices.

Read the borough-wide housing investigation and the other developments: https://rochdaledaily.co.uk/articles/rochdale-housing-developments-affordability-schools-gp-transport.html
